label: Instant asset write-off limit (aggregated turnover under $10 million)
notes: The table gives no end date. The $20,000 limit from 1 July 2023 was a temporary increase, which the ATO legislation update says was last extended to 30 June 2026 by the Treasury Laws Amendment (Strengthening Financial Systems and Other Measures) Act 2025. From 1 July 2026 the permanent limit is the record instant-asset-write-off-threshold-from-2026-07-01. For the full-cost deduction, each eligible depreciating asset must cost less than $20,000. Separate rules cover later additions to an asset's cost; other conditions and exclusions apply.
